###data quick summary

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)

dat <- read_csv("data/fitfr_clean.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    treatment = factor(treatment, levels = c("A", "B", "C")),
    pr = factor(pr, levels = c("No", "Yes"))
  )

# 1. N
tab_n <- dat %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarise(value = as.character(n()), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(variable = "N")

# 2. Age
tab_age <- dat %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    value = sprintf("%.1f ± %.1f", mean(age, na.rm = TRUE), sd(age, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(variable = "Age (mean ± SD)")

# 3. Female
tab_female <- dat %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    n_female = sum(sex == "Female", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_total = n(),
    value = sprintf("%d (%.0f%%)", n_female, 100 * n_female / n_total),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  select(treatment, value) %>%
  mutate(variable = "Female n (%)")

# 4. AF
tab_af <- dat %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    value = sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f", mean(af, na.rm = TRUE), sd(af, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(variable = "AF (mean ± SD)")

# 5. PR yes
tab_pr <- dat %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    n_yes = sum(pr == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_total = n(),
    value = sprintf("%d (%.0f%%)", n_yes, 100 * n_yes / n_total),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  select(treatment, value) %>%
  mutate(variable = "PR yes n (%)")

summary_table <- bind_rows(tab_n, tab_age, tab_female, tab_af, tab_pr) %>%
  select(variable, treatment, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = treatment, values_from = value)

print(summary_table)
```

Independently analysis the relationship:

AF \~ treatment

AF \~ age

PR \~ treatment

PR \~ age

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

dat <- read_csv("data/fitfr_analysis.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    treatment = factor(treatment, levels = c("A", "B", "C")),
    sex = factor(sex),
    pr = factor(pr, levels = c("No", "Yes"))
  )


treat_cols <- c(
  "A" = "#D8A7A7",   
  "B" = "#7FA6C9",   
  "C" = "#B7D7B0"    
)

# 1. AF by treatment
p1 <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = treatment, y = af, fill = treatment)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.85, width = 0.65, outlier.alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = treat_cols) +
  labs(
    title = "AF by treatment group",
    x = "Treatment",
    y = "AF"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

print(p1)

# 2. AF vs age
p2 <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = age, y = af, color = treatment)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = treat_cols) +
  labs(
    title = "Relationship between age and AF",
    x = "Age",
    y = "AF",
    color = "Treatment"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

print(p2)

# 3. PR by treatment
pr_treat <- dat %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    pr_yes = mean(pr == "Yes"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p3 <- ggplot(pr_treat, aes(x = treatment, y = pr_yes, fill = treatment)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = treat_cols) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Proportion of PR = Yes by treatment group",
    x = "Treatment",
    y = "PR = Yes (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

print(p3)

# 4. PR vs age
dat_agebin <- dat %>%
  mutate(age_group = cut(
    age,
    breaks = c(20, 30, 40, 50),
    right = FALSE,
    include.lowest = TRUE
  )) %>%
  group_by(age_group) %>%
  summarise(
    pr_yes = mean(pr == "Yes"),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p4 <- ggplot(dat_agebin, aes(x = age_group, y = pr_yes)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65, fill = "#9FB7C9", alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Proportion of PR = Yes across age groups",
    x = "Age group",
    y = "PR = Yes (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

print(p4)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

dat <- read_csv("data/fitfr_analysis.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    treatment = factor(treatment, levels = c("A", "B", "C")),
    sex = factor(sex),
    pr = factor(pr, levels = c("No", "Yes"))
  )


# 1. AF model: linear regression

af_model <- lm(af ~ treatment + age + sex, data = dat)

cat("===== AF model =====\n")
summary(af_model)

cat("\n===== AF model ANOVA =====\n")
anova(af_model)

# 2. PR model: logistic regression
pr_model <- glm(pr ~ treatment + age + sex, data = dat, family = binomial)

cat("\n===== PR model =====\n")
summary(pr_model)

cat("\n===== PR model odds ratios =====\n")
exp(cbind(OR = coef(pr_model), confint(pr_model)))

```

\

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(broom)

dat <- read_csv("data/fitfr_analysis.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    treatment = factor(treatment, levels = c("A", "B", "C")),
    sex = factor(sex),
    pr = factor(pr, levels = c("No", "Yes"))
  )

#find SNP colomn
snp_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), "^rs")]


# 1. AF screening
af_results <- lapply(snp_cols, function(snp) {
  tmp <- dat %>%
    select(af, treatment, age, sex, all_of(snp)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[snp]])) %>%
    mutate(snp_var = factor(.data[[snp]]))

  if (n_distinct(tmp$snp_var) < 2) return(NULL)
  
  fit <- lm(af ~ snp_var + treatment + age + sex, data = tmp)
  a <- anova(fit)
  
  # get P_value
  p <- a["snp_var", "Pr(>F)"]
  
  tibble(
    SNP = snp,
    n = nrow(tmp),
    p_value = p
  )
})

af_results <- bind_rows(af_results) %>%
  mutate(
    FDR = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_value)

print(af_results)

# 2. PR screening
pr_results <- lapply(snp_cols, function(snp) {
  tmp <- dat %>%
    select(pr, treatment, age, sex, all_of(snp)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[snp]])) %>%
    mutate(snp_var = factor(.data[[snp]]))
  
  if (n_distinct(tmp$snp_var) < 2) return(NULL)
  
  fit <- glm(pr ~ snp_var + treatment + age + sex,
             data = tmp,
             family = binomial)
  
  d <- drop1(fit, test = "Chisq")
  p <- d["snp_var", "Pr(>Chi)"]
  
  tibble(
    SNP = snp,
    n = nrow(tmp),
    p_value = p
  )
})

pr_results <- bind_rows(pr_results) %>%
  mutate(
    FDR = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_value)

print(pr_results)

# save
write_csv(af_results, "output/af_snp_ranking.csv")
write_csv(pr_results, "output/pr_snp_ranking.csv")

# 3. get top 10
af_top10 <- af_results %>% slice_head(n = 10)
pr_top10 <- pr_results %>% slice_head(n = 10)

print(af_top10)
print(pr_top10)

# 4. AF plot
p_af <- af_top10 %>%
  mutate(SNP = reorder(SNP, p_value)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = SNP, y = -log10(p_value))) +
  geom_col(fill = "#7FA6C9", alpha = 0.9) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Top candidate SNPs for AF",
    x = "SNP",
    y = "-log10(p-value)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

print(p_af)

# 5. PR plot
p_pr <- pr_top10 %>%
  mutate(SNP = reorder(SNP, p_value)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = SNP, y = -log10(p_value))) +
  geom_col(fill = "#D9A679", alpha = 0.9) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Top candidate SNPs for PR",
    x = "SNP",
    y = "-log10(p-value)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

print(p_pr)

# save
ggsave("figs/af_top10_snp.png", p_af, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
ggsave("figs/pr_top10_snp.png", p_pr, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```
